answer: Yes, you don't have to call them yourself. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts, so you can sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, and we'll ask Summit for the dealer payoff quote for you. Keep in mind that the dealer payoff quote can be different from the payoff Summit quotes to you. If our offer is higher than the buyout amount, Summit gives that difference (the lease equity) to you.
